marketing_description: The DeWALT DCF510B 20V Max Cordless Ratchet features a 1/4 in square drive and delivers 45 ft-lb of torque. This tool has a variable speed setting with a speed rating of 0 to 550 RPM and is designed with an ergonomic rubber handle for comfortable use. The compact design and long-lasting 20V Max 5 Ah battery make it a reliable choice for a variety of applications.
